result.evidence_quote: Baseline gut ecology significantly conditioned long-term BS outcomes: patients in the highest quartile of baseline Bifidobacterium spp. lost significantly less fat mass at 24 months than those in the lowest (6.6% vs. 13.2%, p = 0.010).
result.rationale: The study has peripheral relevance through obesity, fat loss, and diabetes status, which relate to cardiovascular risk prevention. Its central focus is microbiome adaptation and bariatric surgery outcomes; it does not evaluate cardiovascular disease, cardiovascular risk prediction, or cardiovascular outcomes.
